titre: Reporting your separation to the Caf
resume: Report the separation online so that your entitlements are recalculated on your own resources alone, and choose who receives the benefits with shared residence (cerfa n° 14000).
aQuoiCaSert: After a separation, your benefits (family allowances, housing benefit, prime d'activité (in-work benefit), ASF (allocation de soutien familial, family support allowance)...) are recalculated without your ex-partner's income. Reporting the change quickly opens new entitlements and avoids having to repay overpayments. With shared residence, both parents must also tell the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office), or the MSA (Mutualité sociale agricole, the farmers' social security fund), who receives the benefits.
quiEstConcerne: Any Caf or MSA beneficiary who separates, whether married, in a PACS (civil partnership) or living together.
The ex-partner who was not the beneficiary and must open their own file to receive benefits.
Parents with shared residence, who must choose the beneficiary.
aSavoir: Shared residence is taken into account if it results from a decision of the family court judge (juge aux affaires familiales, JAF) that is actually applied, a joint declaration by the parents, or one parent's declaration not disputed by the other.
Shared residence, if you agree: the parents name a single beneficiary for all benefits, or split the family allowances in half and name a single beneficiary for the other benefits.
Shared residence, if you disagree: each parent automatically receives a share of the family allowances; the other benefits go in full to the designated parent.
In mainland France, family allowances are not paid with only one dependent child: so there is nothing to split.
The choice can only be changed after one year (unless the child's residence changes), then it is renewed automatically.

Only family allowances are split. Exception: since December 1, 2025, each parent can receive the complément de libre choix du mode de garde (CMG, childcare allowance) according to their own situation.

Residence with one parent only, with no child support paid by the other: you may be entitled to the family support allowance (see the guide entry "Family support allowance (ASF, allocation de soutien familial)").
